[RTCT.5.3] **RT-mode behaviour.** When the binary runs in
`rt` mode against a `.dsc` carrying a contract, all caps
defined in [RTCT.7] are enforced exactly as in the
production runtime. A contract breach during a profile
capture is a fatal runtime error (`DS_ERR_CONTRACT_BREACH`)
and aborts the capture; the partial `.profile` MAY be
written but is marked
`measurement.aborted_on_contract_breach: true` if so.
